rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for acting on someone’s behalf, representing a political group, standing for something, or being an example of it.

example.english: They represent us in talks with the principal.
example.jyutping: keoi5 doi6 biu2 ngo5 dei6 tung4 haau6 zoeng2 king1

rows.note: Use this when parts or factors make up or form a larger whole.

example.english: Water, sugar, and lemon juice represent what this lemon tea is made of.
example.traditional: 水、糖同檸檬汁組成呢杯檸檬茶。
example.jyutping: seoi2 tong4 tung4 ning4 mung1 zap1 zou2 sing4 ni1 bui1 ning4 mung1 caa4

rows.note: Use this when something constitutes a particular proportion or percentage of a whole.

example.english: This part will represent thirty percent of the company's income.
example.traditional: 呢部分佔咗全公司收入嘅三成。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 fan6 zim3 zo2 cyun4 gung1 si1 sau1 jap6 ge3 saam1 sing4

rows.note: Use this when a thing functions specifically as a symbol of an idea, usually instead of the broader 代表.

example.english: The white dove serves to represent world peace.
example.jyutping: baak6 gap3 zoeng6 zing1 sai3 gaai3 wo4 ping4
